questions.prompt: Which statement correctly describes Advanced Container Delivery?
options: Run untrusted pull-request code in the same job that holds production credentials.
Advanced container delivery validates, scans, tags, signs or attests where supported, and promotes the same identified image instead of rebuilding per environment.
Give every job write permission to avoid troubleshooting authorization errors.
Print all environment variables and event payloads to make the run easier to debug.
questions.answer_key: Advanced container delivery validates, scans, tags, signs or attests where supported, and promotes the same identified image instead of rebuilding per environment.
questions.explanation: This is the central behavior of advanced container delivery: Advanced container delivery validates, scans, tags, signs or attests where supported, and promotes the same identified image instead of rebuilding per environment. Validate configuration and behavior against the current official reference before production use.

questions.prompt: How should a reviewer verify a change related to advanced container delivery?
options: Publish the workflow to production before reviewing its triggers and permissions.
Run a controlled test or static check, inspect the relevant job and step result, and compare the evidence with the stated acceptance criteria.
Assume the workflow is correct as soon as the YAML file is committed.
Retry every failure without looking at the exit code or preserving evidence.
questions.answer_key: Run a controlled test or static check, inspect the relevant job and step result, and compare the evidence with the stated acceptance criteria.
questions.explanation: Reliable verification uses observable evidence.
